action_cost.treatment: Do not subtract an invented action cost; report gross revenue and break-even differential cost

development_selection.positive_point: freeze TEST_DELAYED_PRICE if integrity passes and 95% upper bound is above 0

personalization.reason: Neither field dataset exposes five lawful pretreatment features

study1.ci: paired Student-t 95% interval over date contrasts
study1.estimand: mean across dates of (delayed raw ARS revenue / delayed assigned visitors) - (immediate raw ARS revenue / immediate assigned visitors)
study1.primary_outcome: raw sales revenue in ARS per assigned unique daily visitor
study1.split: first 28 ordered date_id values DEVELOPMENT; final 28 VALIDATION; no SEALED_TEST

study3.estimand: mean weekly raw ARS revenue per randomized recipient under delayed minus immediate disclosure
study3.primary_outcome: raw weekly sales revenue in ARS per randomized recipient
study3.split: deterministic SHA-256 recipient split 50% DEVELOPMENT, 25% VALIDATION, 25% SEALED_TEST

validation_gate.avoid: reference minus alternative point estimate positive and two-sided 95% lower bound above 0
validation_gate.non_reference_action: action minus reference point estimate positive and two-sided 95% lower bound above 0
